name: Code Editor
description: A VS Code-style workbench in the browser: single files or whole folders, tabs and breadcrumbs, search, Source Control with inline git gutters, split terminals, Problems/Output panels and an AI chat tab. File access stays in EthOS behind its path scope, so this package ships the desktop app only.
author: SyncHot
changelog: 1.0.1: light code theme (VS Code Light+ tokens and chrome), the terminal follows the appearance toggle, and unsaved changes show in the status bar instead of overriding the window title; requires EthOS 2.0. 1.0.0: first release. The Code Editor desktop app moves out of the core install; editing, git and terminal endpoints stay in EthOS, and File Station still opens files in it.
